name: Pom Coong
kicker: Quieter White Thai village in the valley
summary: Walk the quieter White Thai village and see the cloth under the stilt floor. Sleep here for the same rice and a smaller lane than Bản Lác. About 70 households and more than 300 people live in the center of xã Mai Châu. It was also placed in the township. Houses stand about 2 m off the ground. After dinner the floor has xòe, sạp, and instruments. A fee and the minutes are check on arrival.
getThere: A short walk or a bicycle from Bản Lác. The minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Cloth hung under a stilt house in Pom Coong
gettingThere: Pom Coọng is in the center of xã Mai Châu. It was also placed in the township. Both stay. From Bản Lác, or from the town bus drop, it is a short walk or a bicycle along the valley. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Bản Lác
legs.body: On foot or by bicycle along the valley. The walk from the town bus drop is short. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Reach the valley first. About 140 km, and also about 150 km, about 130 km from the center, and about 157 km from Nội Bài. About three hours via Hòa Bình, and also 2.5 hours. Then the short walk above. The fare is check on arrival.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. A separate ticket for the evening is check on arrival.
